prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in in Katy, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd prefer to just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit from behind. Is that okay?

Q: That works for the record. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road, waiting for the left turn signal. My car was completely still. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, I didn't. I was looking ahead at the light. I only saw it in my mirror a split second before it hit.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right after the impact?

A: My knee hit the dashboard. It hurt right away, but I thought it was just a bruise. By that evening it was swollen and I could barely bend it.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next day. They took X-rays and told me to see an orthopedic specialist. I have an MRI scheduled and I'm using crutches to walk around the house.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any pain in other parts of your body?

A: My neck is stiff and I have some lower back soreness, but the knee is the worst of it.

Q: Did you miss any time from work?

A: Yes, I've been off work for about a week and I'm waiting to hear from my doctor about returning.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been cooperating fully and I want this resolved fairly. I'm happy to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
